# einvoicecost.ae

> UAE e-invoicing cost calculator and done-for-you setup. Shows the exact price upfront for your software and your exact invoice count, with no slabs or brackets. Most providers only quote after a sales call. Prices updated: 11 November 2026. Prices in AED, excluding 5% VAT.

## Key facts
- UAE businesses under AED 50 million revenue must appoint an Accredited Service Provider (ASP) by 31 March 2027 and go live with e-invoicing on 1 July 2027. Businesses with revenue of AED 50 million and above had to appoint by 30 October 2026 and go live on 1 January 2027.
- Fine for appointing an ASP late: AED 5,000 a month. After go-live, each invoice not issued electronically can be fined AED 100, up to AED 5,000 a month.
- QuickBooks (Online and Desktop), Excel and most other software are not ASPs, so they need an outside ASP and a connection. einvoicecost.ae handles the full setup.
- Zoho Books, TallyPrime and Wafeq are ASPs themselves (built-in e-invoicing).
- B2C sales are outside the UAE e-invoicing system.

## Prices (AED, excluding 5% VAT), checked 11 November 2026

Software without built-in e-invoicing (QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Excel, any other software):
- Onboarding & ASP registration: 1,000 one time
- Setup: 1,500 one time
- Auto-send connector: QuickBooks Online 2,000; QuickBooks Desktop 3,000; Excel not needed (upload); other software quoted on WhatsApp
- Platform fee: 1,000 per year
- E-invoicing: 500 per year for up to 500 invoices, then exact invoice count, no slabs
- First year at 500 invoices: QuickBooks Online 6,000; QuickBooks Desktop 7,000; Excel 4,000; other software 4,000 + connector
- Every year after at 500 invoices: 1,500

Built-in e-invoicing (Zoho Books, TallyPrime, Wafeq): no ASP fee, no connector, no platform fee. Optional setup by us: 1,500 one time.

Switching software: we move data from QuickBooks or Excel to Zoho Books, TallyPrime or Wafeq. Price depends on the data; fixed quote on WhatsApp. Page: https://einvoicecost.ae/switch-accounting-software

Deadlines: revenue under AED 50M appoint ASP by 31 March 2027, go live 1 July 2027. Revenue AED 50M and above appoint by 30 October 2026, go live 1 January 2027. Late appointment fine AED 5,000 a month.

Above 500 invoices you pay for your exact number of invoices, no slabs or brackets. Supplier invoices you receive are not counted.
